protocol — Valorant coach notebook
==================================

1. Double-click protocol.exe: the notebook opens in its own window.
2. Close the window when you are done: the program stops by itself.

The whole notebook is one file, protocol.carnet, created next to the program:
maps, notes, images, bin. Copy protocol.exe and protocol.carnet together to a
USB stick, a shared folder or OneDrive: your notebook goes with you. Nothing
is written anywhere else on the computer (the window uses a temporary browser
profile, deleted when it closes).

Language: English or French, following your system. Change it in
Help › Langue / Language.

Copy and paste:
  - "Copy" on a note, a map or a match sheet, then paste into Discord or into
    Word, Google Docs, Notion (formatting kept).
  - Ctrl+V on a notebook page: copied text (Discord, Word, Docs…) becomes a
    new note, already filled in.
  - .md files dropped on a map are imported.
  - Help › Your notebook: the whole notebook as Markdown files (.zip), for
    Obsidian or a backup readable anywhere.

AI assistant (Claude Desktop, Claude Code): Help › AI assistant (MCP) gives
  the configuration to copy, read-only or with writing. Nothing is
  irreversible: whatever the assistant removes or rewrites stays in the bin.

Shortcuts: / search · N new note · E edit · F match sheet
           C copy · [ ] switch map · ? help

Windows may show a SmartScreen warning on first launch (unsigned program):
"More info", then "Run anyway".

Command line: protocol --help
